label: Writing the product of sums
subgoals: Name a variable for each row
Write one clause per column listing the rows that cover it
Drop duplicate clauses and clauses that contain another clause

label: Expanding into covers
subgoals: Apply idempotence and absorption after each multiplication
Read each surviving product as an irredundant cover

label: Choosing the minimum
subgoals: Score each product by row count or total literal cost
Select the least-cost product as the minimum cover
Count ties among the minimum-cost products
